results.title: tempPauser zero-gate in PostMigrationCleanup always reverts on a valid prod run after a clean Step 1

evidence.tempPauserIsLegitimatelyZero: DeployTempStableStakerAndMigrators.s.sol:256 records tempStaker.pauser() BEFORE line 270-271 sets it to OWNER; a freshly-deployed StableStaker leaves pauser==address(0) (StableStaker.sol:55 'address public override pauser;' uninitialized, no ctor assignment), so the recorded value is a legitimate zero, persisted at line 303

results.title: promised 'ultimate gate' zero-haircut assertion absent from post-migration assert

evidence.floorAdded: PostMigrationCleanup.s.sol:247-256 require(principalOf >= preMigBooked) per token, '>=' floor (correct direction; '==' would falsely revert on legit surplus)
evidence.floorIsSound_whenAnchorCorrect: On a clean first run the anchor is pinned: SkimAndLeg1 preflight 204-218 requires leg1-stakers.json totalStaked == on-chain poolInfo[3] (gated stakerCount>0). Downstream-only protection is sound IF step9 runs after step8 re-books principal (interStepDependencyGraph CRITICAL ordering).
evidence.subQuestion_a_threadingTamperFree: preMigBooked is sourced from leg1-stakers.json (vm.toString(parseJsonUint(.totalStaked))) NOT a live read; read back bare in step9 (reverts if missing). Tamper-free across the JSON bus ONLY while leg1-stakers.json is not re-gathered post-drain.
evidence.subQuestion_c_gap_CONFIRMED: The fix is self-defeating on a resume. SkimAndLeg1 count-staleness preflight (lines 187-194) hard-requires leg1.count == on-chain stakerCount and the error message instructs 're-run gather'. After leg1 drains the pool (stakerCount->0, totalStaked->0) and the broadcast halts BEFORE the preMigBooked persistence block (lines 393-402, the LAST writes in run()), a resume FORCES a re-gather. gather-migration-inputs.js reads totalStaked LIVE from poolInfo[3] (line 257-263) and overwrites leg1-stakers.json with post-drain 0. SkimAndLeg1 re-run then SKIPS the totalStaked==chain preflight (stakerCount==0 gate, line 204) and persists dolaPreMigBooked/usdcPreMigBooked = 0. Step9 floor degrades to require(principalOf >= 0): VACUOUS. The story-067 author's own comment (SkimAndLeg1:388-392) claims a resume 're-persists the IDENTICAL value instead of post-drain 0' - that is FALSE once the forced re-gather rewrites the snapshot.
evidence.combinedWithPhase4UnderDelivery: _prefundShortfall (SkimAndLeg1:523-528) only WARNS on injected<shortfall, never reverts; ResetAndRewire ceiling is one-sided '<=' (does not catch under-credit). With preMigBooked zeroed, the step9 floor was the SOLE end-to-end zero-haircut protection, so a real staker haircut reaches step9 uncaught.
evidence.poc: test/PoC_YS25_PreMigBookedResumeZeroing.t.sol - 2 tests PASS: first-run floor catches a 1% haircut; resume re-gather zeroes preMigBooked and the same haircut passes the gate vacuously.
evidence.existingTestsInsufficient: YsSwapMigrationHardening.t.sol test_zeroHaircutGate_* only unit-test a re-declared copy of the require expression (zeroHaircutGateDola/Usdc) pinning message+direction; they do NOT exercise the preMigBooked JSON-bus threading or the resume re-gather path, so they pass while the gap is live.

results.title: story-062 live-staker pause has no break-glass

evidence.standalone: Reads NO ys-swap-deployments.json and NO migration-inputs; only constants + live staker reads. Does not depend on a complete/partial migration artifact.
evidence.accessControl: StableStaker.unpause() requires msg.sender == owner() || pauser (StableStaker.sol:282). Script uses owner 0xCad1...D0B6 and preflights require(staker.owner()==OWNER). Live fork read confirms owner == 0xCad1...D0B6.
evidence.idempotent: Early-returns if !paused() (lines 65-68) - safe to run when staker already live.
evidence.forkPreview: PREVIEW_MODE=true forge script ... ran successfully against fork @25313223; live staker currently unpaused -> 'already unpaused - nothing to do'.
evidence.forkProof: fork test (transient): forced live staker into deploy-step paused state (setPauser(OWNER)+pause via prank), then owner unpause() succeeded, paused()==false. Confirms it unsticks a mid-suite halt that strands the live USDe pool.
evidence.noStateRequired: A halted run that paused the staker (deploy step took pauser role + paused) leaves exactly the state breakglass needs: owner unchanged, staker paused. No downstream artifact required.

candidateFindings.title: YS-swap zero-haircut floor (story-067) is silently disabled on a leg-1 resume: forced re-gather zeroes preMigBooked
candidateFindings.label: YS-26
candidateFindings.description: story-067 added a zero-haircut FLOOR in PostMigrationCleanup: require(principalOf(token, original) >= preMigBooked). preMigBooked is persisted by SkimAndLeg1Migration from leg1-stakers.json's .totalStaked snapshot. That snapshot is produced by gather-migration-inputs.js, which reads totalStaked LIVE from on-chain poolInfo[3]. SkimAndLeg1's own count-staleness preflight (lines 187-194) hard-reverts with 'stale ... re-run gather' whenever leg1-stakers.json .count != on-chain stakerCount. After leg1 drains the pool (stakerCount->0, totalStaked->0) and the broadcast halts BEFORE the preMigBooked persistence block (lines 393-402, the final writes in run()), a resume FORCES the operator to re-gather. The re-gather overwrites the snapshot's totalStaked with the post-drain value 0. On the SkimAndLeg1 re-run, the totalStaked==on-chain preflight (lines 204-218) is SKIPPED because stakerCount==0, so the script persists preMigBooked = 0. The step-9 floor then degrades to require(principalOf >= 0) - vacuously true. The author's own code comment (lines 388-392) asserts a resume 're-persists the IDENTICAL value instead of the post-drain 0'; the forced re-gather makes that assumption false.
candidateFindings.impact: The zero-haircut floor is the SOLE end-to-end protection that a two-leg migration never shortchanges a staker: ResetAndRewire's step-6 post-assert is a one-sided '<=' over-credit CEILING (does not catch under-credit), and SkimAndLeg1's Phase-4 _prefundShortfall only WARNs (never reverts) when injected < shortfall. With preMigBooked silently zeroed on the resume path, a real haircut (Phase-4 under-prefund + sub-swept principal) flows through step 9 uncaught and reaches users who then withdraw less than their booked principal. No malice and no concurrency required - it is reachable through the documented resume runbook (the script's own error message directs the operator to re-gather).
candidateFindings.evidence: SkimAndLeg1Migration.s.sol:187-194 (count preflight forces re-gather), :204-218 (totalStaked preflight skipped when stakerCount==0), :393-402 (persists preMigBooked from snapshot, last writes), :388-392 (false 'identical value' comment); scripts/gather-migration-inputs.js:257-263,326 (totalStaked read live, file overwritten); PostMigrationCleanup.s.sol:247-256 (floor); PoC test/PoC_YS25_PreMigBookedResumeZeroing.t.sol (2 PASS).
candidateFindings.recommendation: Make preMigBooked write-once / tamper-evident: (1) In SkimAndLeg1, before persisting, read back any existing .dolaPreMigBooked/.usdcPreMigBooked via try/parseJsonUint and refuse to OVERWRITE a previously-recorded non-zero value with a smaller one (idempotent re-persist of the original, not the post-drain 0). (2) OR hard-require preMigBooked > 0 in PostMigrationCleanup (lines 247-256) so a zeroed anchor fails loud instead of passing vacuously - reject the gate value the way YS-22 rejects an unrecorded pauser. (3) OR source preMigBooked from a snapshot file that is NEVER overwritten on resume (e.g. a separate first-run-only premig-booked.json gated on its own absence). (4) Make _prefundShortfall HARD-REVERT on injected < shortfall rather than WARN, removing the reliance on a single downstream gate.
